mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the negative rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 exceeding 2% indicates a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered months, or the negative rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months indicates a contraction in industrial production, which reduces earnings visibility and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and < previous month - 0.5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC drops below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDPC1 and HOUST above their 12-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12M MA and HOUST > 12M MA simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered episodes, or the positive rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% combined with a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% for two months signals a policy-lag environment where monetary easing fails to offset inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% AND CPIAUCSL > 3% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending power, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RSAFS above its 5-year moving average for six consecutive months signals a surge in household savings that outpaces spending, which dampens economic growth and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the negative rank IC is below 0.03.
